text: Terminal no-go for this performance campaign. Checked-in AArch64 JDK 21/25 receipts show genuine candidates (extrema, Int sum/product, Long sum) but no x86-64 receipt, no integration-specific scalar fallback/module-loading design, and an incubator dependency requiring add-modules plus benchmark-only bytecode workarounds. Long product remains a measured 0.13-0.14x rejection; contiguous add and JDK 21 sine also lose. The acceptance contract explicitly closes candidates lacking cross-architecture/fallback proof as no-go rather than promoting them.
